# Milestone 6 (part): splitting a calibration budget across subgroups (generated by summarise.py)

73 families (item x kind, tradition families per source) with 2 to 4 groups; families per budget: n&#772; = 50: 73, n&#772; = 100: 72, n&#772; = 200: 69, n&#772; = 400: 55. Ratio = family loss (mean group MSE) over the difference estimator with an equal split (D_eq); below 1 is better. Median over families, item-cluster bootstrap 95% interval.

## Allocation

- oracle water-filling gives a group zero calibration respondents in 28% of group x budget cases (n&#772; = 50: 40%; 400: 18%)
- FH2 mean n per group relative to n&#772;: quartiles 0.93, 1.00, 1.08

## Prediction checks (LOG.md, 2026-11-13)

1. D_ney median ratio in [0.97, 1.00] at every n&#772;: 0.993, 0.997, 0.996, 0.994
2. C_or at most 0.60 at 50 (0.259); 0.75 to 0.95 at 400 (0.559)
3. FH_prior at most (1 + C_or)/2 at 50 (0.501 vs 0.629) and 100 (0.685 vs 0.675); at most 1.02 at 400 (0.885)
4. FH_fam minus FH_prior at 50 at least 0.05: 0.156
5. FH2 / FH_prior loss within 5% at every n&#772;: 1.024 (mean), 1.029 (mean), 1.029 (mean), 1.018 (mean)
6. FH_prior worst-group RMSE ratio above 1 at 50: 0.747
Refutation (FH_prior at 50 at least 0.97): 0.501
